sqlquery.from: ( select distinct u.id , max( coalesce(u.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(u.lastname,'')) employeename , sum(case r.code when 'NOT_STARTED' then 1 else 0 end) notstarted , sum(case r.code when 'IN_PROGRESS' then 1 else 0 end) inprogres , sum(case r.code not in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') and t.dueDate is not null when true then 1 else 0 end) overdue from "$".task t left join "$".reference r on t.statusid=r.id left join "$".employeetask et on t.id=et.taskid left join "$".projectEmployee pe on et.projectEmployeeId=pe.id left join "$".teamEmployee te on pe.employeeDepartmentId=te.id left join "$".myuser u on te.employeeId=u.id ,(select mu.users_id userid,max(case r.code when 'TL' then 1 else 0 end) TL,max(tm.id) teamID ,max(case r.code when 'ADMIN' then 1 else 0 end) isadmin from "$".myuser_role mu join "$".role r on mu.roles_id=r.id and mu.users_id=2 left join "$".team tm on tm.leaderid=mu.users_id and tm.isdeleted is not true group by mu.users_id) rl where u.deleted is not true and t.deleted is not true and u.id is not null and trim(coalesce(u.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(u.lastname,''))!='' and u.deleted is not true and (t.isissue is not true) and ( (rl.tl=1 and te.teamId=rl.teamID) or (rl.tl=0 and u.id=rl.userid) or rl.isadmin=1 ) and ( #?replacement?# ) group by u.id )t
